audience: marketing agencies that manage client accounts, keyword rankings and backlinks in AgencyAnalytics

useCases.title: Compare clients by keyword rankings
useCases.text: List the clients, then read the keyword rankings and the ranking history of one client.

useCases.title: Review tracked keywords of a client
useCases.text: List the tracked keywords of one client, and read the client record by id.

useCases.title: Add a new client with a competitor
useCases.text: Create a client from its company name and URL, then add a competitor to that client.

useCases.title: Track a backlink for a client
useCases.text: List the Backlink Manager records, then add a backlink record for a client.

useCases.title: Review account users and their roles
useCases.text: List the users of the account with the fields you ask for, and read one user by id.
